numerical_simulation_of_shsvd.solve_shsvd_single_run¶

numerical_simulation_of_shsvd.solve_shsvd_single_run(flow_function, jump_rate_function, transition_function, initial_value, t_span, jump_rate_bound=None, jump_times=None, jump_time_transition_function=None, jump_set_function=None, jump_set_transition_function=None, t_eval=None, flow_args=None, jump_rate_args=None, transition_args=None, jump_time_transition_args=None, jump_set_args=None, jump_set_transition_args=None, check_jump_rate=False, solve_ivp_method='RK45', **solve_ivp_options)¶

Executes a single run of the stochastic hybrid system dynamics.

This function runs the integration of the system defined by the flow_function as well as forced transitions while computing an execution of the random variable given by the jump_rate_function and transitions specified by transition_function.

Parameters:

  • flow_function (callable) – The function that defines the flow of the system.

  • jump_rate_function (callable) – The function that defines the jump rate of the system.

  • transition_function (callable) – The function that defines the transition behavior.

  • initial_value (array-like) – The initial state of the system.

  • t_span (tuple) – A tuple specifying the start and end times for integration.

  • jump_rate_bound (float, optional) – The upper bound of the jump rate. If none is provided, it will be estimated during simulation.

  • jump_times (list, optional) – A list of times at which jumps occur.

  • jump_time_transition_function (callable, optional) – A function that defines the transition at jump occurrences. It is set to transition_function if jump_times are given, but no jump_time_transition_function.

  • jump_set_function (callable, optional) – A function that defines the conditions for a jump to occur.

  • jump_set_transition_function (callable, optional) – A function that defines the transition behavior for jump sets. It isbset to transition_function if a jump_set_function is given, but no jump_time_transition_function.

  • t_eval (array-like, optional) – Specific times at which to store the computed solution.

  • flow_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the flow_function.

  • jump_rate_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_rate_function.

  • transition_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the transition_function.

  • jump_time_transition_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_time_transition_function.

  • jump_set_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_set_function.

  • jump_set_transition_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_set_transition_function.

  • check_jump_rate (bool, optional) – If True, check if jump_rate_bound was violated in each step. Automatically set to True, if no jump_rate_bound is provided.

  • solve_ivp_method (str, optional) – The method to use for solving the initial value problem (default is ‘RK45’).

  • solve_ivp_options (keyword arguments, optional) – Additional options for the solve_ivp function.

Returns:

FunctionOfVariableDimension

An object containing the time and value data of the system after integration during this single run.

Return type:

func
